disclaimer: Agricultural recommendations are strictly geo-fenced and verified by accredited agronomists. Comply with local pesticide regulations, withholding periods, and product label instructions.

rules.recommended_action: Apply preventive copper-based contact fungicide. Prune bottom leaves in contact with soil to enhance air circulation.
rules.dosage: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0-2.5 g/liter of water, or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide spray @ 5 g/liter and Trichoderma viride soil amendment.
rules.safety_notes: Wear protective gloves and mask. Observe 7-day pre-harvest interval (PHI). Do not spray during peak midday temperatures.
rules.verified_by: Dr. R. K. Sharma (State Agricultural University Extension Specialist)

rules.recommended_action: Apply targeted translaminar fungicide alternating mode of action to avoid resistance.
rules.dosage: Azoxystrobin 22.9% @ 6.0 fl oz/acre or Difenoconazole @ 7.0 fl oz/acre.
rules.organic_alternative: Copper octanoate (copper soap) @ 1.5-2.0 fl oz/gallon.
rules.safety_notes: Restricted entry interval (REI) 12 hours. Maximum 4 applications per crop cycle.
rules.verified_by: Prof. E. Davis (Cornell Cooperative Extension)

rules.recommended_action: Immediate containment required due to explosive spread under high humidity. Destroy severely infected culms.
rules.dosage: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/liter, or Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Bordeaux mixture 1% spray as protective shield before high-rain fronts.
rules.safety_notes: Urgent notification to neighboring growers. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.
rules.verified_by: Dr. M. Laurent (International Horticultural Disease Panel)

rules.recommended_action: Apply preventive systemic fungicide at first report of regional blight outbreak.
rules.dosage: Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1.0 g/liter or Fluopicolide + Propamocarb @ 2.0 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Fixed copper hydroxide sprays on 5-7 day intervals.
rules.safety_notes: PHI 14 days before harvest. Ensure complete canopy penetration and underside leaf wetting.
rules.verified_by: Dr. S. O'Connor (Potato Pathology Research Institute)

rules.recommended_action: Drain standing water temporarily. Cease all nitrogen top-dressing immediately. Apply bactericide + copper spray.
rules.dosage: Streptocycline (90:10 Streptomycin + Tetracycline) @ 6 g + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g in 200 liters water/acre.
rules.organic_alternative: Fresh cow dung supernatant slurry spray (5%) or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Use only where registered for field crops. Maintain field sanitation and clean irrigation channels.
rules.verified_by: Dr. P. N. Rao (National Rice Research Institute)

rules.recommended_action: Maintain shallow water in nursery beds. Apply systemic blast fungicide.
rules.dosage: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/liter or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Seed treatment and seedling dip with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed.
rules.safety_notes: Do not apply excessive nitrogen. Avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
rules.verified_by: Dr. P. N. Rao (National Rice Research Institute)

rules.recommended_action: Spray systemic triazole fungicide at first appearance of yellow stripes.
rules.dosage: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/liter or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.25 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3 g/liter preventive spray.
rules.safety_notes: Spray in early morning when wind is low. Observe 30-day PHI.
rules.verified_by: Dr. A. Verma (Wheat & Barley Research Directorate)

rules.recommended_action: Monitor rust pustules on upper leaves. Apply fungicide if lesions spread above ear leaves before tasseling.
rules.dosage: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1.0 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Wettable sulfur spray @ 2.5 g/liter at cool evening hours.
rules.safety_notes: Ensure personal protective gear during application. Do not feed treated forage within 21 days.
rules.verified_by: Dr. K. Gomez (CIMMYT Field Agronomy Advisor)

rules.recommended_action: Spray bactericide combination on leaves showing angular lesions.
rules.dosage: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/liter + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Spray neem oil 1% + copper hydroxide 1.5 g/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Avoid overhead irrigation. Disinfect pruning and harvesting shears.
rules.verified_by: Dr. H. Patel (Central Institute for Cotton Research)

rules.recommended_action: Spray systemic protectant fungicide to safeguard fruit set and branches from dieback.
rules.dosage: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0 ml/liter or Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2.0 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Seed treatment and foliar spray with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Withholding period 5 days before fruit harvest. Remove rotting fruit from ground.
rules.verified_by: Dr. S. Reddy (Horticultural University Extension)

rules.recommended_action: Critical spray window: from pre-bloom to 4 weeks post-bloom to protect young clusters.
rules.dosage: Myclobutanil 40% WP @ 0.5 g/liter or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Sulfur 80% WP @ 2.0 g/liter + copper hydroxide @ 1.5 g/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Prune mummified berries from vine trellises during winter.
rules.verified_by: Dr. J. Bernard (Viticulture Pathology Board)

rules.recommended_action: Apply curative fungicide within 48-72 hours of primary infection rain event.
rules.dosage: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.3 ml/liter or Captan 50% WP @ 2.5 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Lime sulfur 2-3% spray during green tip through pink bud stage.
rules.safety_notes: Rake and shred fallen apple leaves in autumn to disrupt overwintering ascospores.
rules.verified_by: Dr. C. Weber (Pomology Extension Service)

rules.recommended_action: Deleafing of affected leaves showing mature necrotic spots. Systemic fungicide cycle.
rules.dosage: Epoxiconazole 12.5% SC @ 1.0 ml/liter combined with mineral oil 5 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Mineral oil 10 ml/liter + Bacillus amyloliquefaciens foliar spray.
rules.safety_notes: Alternate chemical groups to mitigate fungicide resistance. Ensure good plantation drainage.
rules.verified_by: Dr. F. Mwangi (Tropical Crop Protection Consortium)

rules.recommended_action: Foliar spray at panicle emergence and fruit set stage.
rules.dosage: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0 ml/liter or Copper Oxychloride @ 3.0 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Pseudomonas fluorescens 10 g/liter foliar spray.
rules.safety_notes: Avoid spraying open blossoms during active honeybee pollination hours.
rules.verified_by: Dr. T. Nair (Horticultural Research Station)

rules.recommended_action: Apply fungicide immediately upon scouting first rust pustules in lower canopy.
rules.dosage: Pyraclostrobin + Fluxapyroxad @ 300 ml/ha or Picoxystrobin + Cyproconazole.
rules.organic_alternative: Sulfur 80% WG @ 2.5 g/liter early preventive application.
rules.safety_notes: Calibrate high-pressure sprayers to ensure penetration through dense foliage.
rules.verified_by: Dr. L. Silva (Embrapa Soybean Pathology)

rules.recommended_action: Foliar application at 35-40 days after sowing or at first lesion detection.
rules.dosage: Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 2.0 ml/liter or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) + Trichoderma spray.
rules.safety_notes: Observe safe waiting period before harvesting haulms for cattle feed.
rules.verified_by: Dr. K. Srinivas (ICRISAT Groundnut Pathology)

rules.recommended_action: Uproot and burn diseased clumps immediately with root system. Do not ratoon infected field.
rules.dosage: Sett treatment with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/liter or hot water treatment at 50°C for 2 hours.
rules.organic_alternative: Dip cane setts in Trichoderma viride suspension @ 10 g/liter for 30 minutes before planting.
rules.safety_notes: Prevent irrigation water flow from diseased fields to healthy fields.
rules.verified_by: Dr. B. Sengupta (Sugarcane Breeding Institute)

rules.recommended_action: Apply preventive copper spray prior to rainy season, followed by systemic triazole if incidence > 5%.
rules.dosage: Bordeaux mixture 0.5% (pre-monsoon) or Cyproconazole 10% EC @ 0.5 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Bordeaux mixture 0.5% + Verticillium lecanii bio-agent spray.
rules.safety_notes: Prune shade trees to allow morning sun penetration into canopy.
rules.verified_by: Dr. C. Hernandez (Central Coffee Research Panel)

rules.recommended_action: Apply copper hydroxide mixed with mancozeb to overcome copper tolerance in bacteria.
rules.dosage: Copper hydroxide 77% WP @ 2.0 g/liter + Mancozeb 75% WP @ 1.5 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Bacillus subtilis strain QST 713 foliar spray.
rules.safety_notes: Do not work in wet fields to prevent mechanical transfer of bacterial slime.
rules.verified_by: Dr. D. Miller (Vegetable Pathology Specialist)

rules.recommended_action: Protect new flush leaves and young fruit with copper sprays. Control citrus leafminer to prevent wound entry.
rules.dosage: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/liter + Streptomycin sulphate @ 100 ppm.
rules.organic_alternative: Copper octanoate @ 2 ml/liter + Horticultural neem oil 1%.
rules.safety_notes: Prune cankered twigs during dry winter dormancy and burn.
rules.verified_by: Dr. R. Al-Hassan (Citrus Health Regulatory Board)

rules.recommended_action: Apply preventive foliar fungicide at flowering stage.
rules.dosage: Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1.0 ml/liter or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Certified pathogen-free seed + Copper soap spray @ 2 g/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Rotate with non-legume crops for at least two consecutive seasons.
rules.verified_by: Dr. E. Otieno (CIAT Bean Research Program)

rules.recommended_action: Control whitefly insect vector (Bemisia tabaci) to halt viral transmission. Roguing of infected plants.
rules.dosage: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/liter or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1.0 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre) + 5% neem seed oil spray.
rules.safety_notes: Rogued plants must be buried or burned immediately to kill viruliferous whiteflies.
rules.verified_by: Dr. K. Swaminathan (ICAR-IIHR Vegetable Protection)

rules.recommended_action: Spray at first sign of powdery talc-like spots on lower leaves.
rules.dosage: Sulfur 80% WDG @ 3.0 g/liter or Penconazole 10% EC @ 0.5 ml/liter.
rules.organic_alternative: Potassium bicarbonate 3 g/liter + horticultural mineral oil 2 ml/liter.
rules.safety_notes: Avoid sulfur sprays when ambient temperatures exceed 32°C to prevent foliar phytotoxicity.
rules.verified_by: Dr. H. Fischer (Pulse Crop Pathology Group)
